mapper.insert: INSERT INTO day_summaries ( checkin_id, user_id, summary_date, completed_json, mood, mood_label, keywords_json, one_liner, highlight, provider, created_at ) VALUES ( #{checkinId}, #{userId}, #{summaryDate}, #{completedJson}, #{mood}, #{moodLabel}, #{keywordsJson}, #{oneLiner}, #{highlight}, #{provider}, #{createdAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checkin_id = VALUES(checkin_id), completed_json = VALUES(completed_json), mood = VALUES(mood), mood_label = VALUES(mood_label), keywords_json = VALUES(keywords_json), one_liner = VALUES(one_liner), highlight = VALUES(highlight), provider = VALUES(provider), created_at = VALUES(created_at)
